en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a wooden church building with a tall square bell tower featuring arched openings and a steep roof. The church has Gothic-style arched windows along the side and front, and a short flight of steps leading up to the entrance. Large trees surround the building, partially obscuring the tower. Printed in red at the bottom is the caption identifying the church and location; there are also some red handwritten or printed numbers on the right side.
